title: Digit Sum Checksum

hidden.label: Power of ten with trailing zeros

hints: You can inspect one digit at a time from right to left using remainder (%) and floor division (//) by 10, or convert the number to text.
With math: while n > 0, add n % 10 to a running total and update n //= 10. With strings: iterate over str(n) and convert each character back with int().

Pseudocode:
  total = 0
  while n > 0:
      total += n % 10
      n //= 10
  return total
